notes.title: QOL Update
notes.content:
Hello!

This will probably be one of the final updates to Serpent Fusion, as I'll soon be busy with college and I've fixed most of the things I didn't like in previous updates.

Thanks for playing and all the support!

Changelog:
- Improved aliasing issues with grid (especially in the map)
- Added delay for movement when a level is started or finished
- Fixed a bug with the volume and fx sliders where they would not load from saved settings

notes.title: Quality of Life/Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Hello All,

This is mainly a bugfix update. Achievements should work now (if you are missing an achievement because of a bug, doing any level should give it to you). I also fixed many other bugs and made some minor visual tweaks.

Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where pushing a box over water when entering a level softlocked your save file
[*]Fixed a bug where if you were a 2-box-long snake you could get a box to phase into your character by using a gate
[*]Fixed a bug where you could push a box after it sunk
[*]Fixed conditions for getting -1 and + achievements
[*]Fixed a bug where the resolution and other default options were not applied correctly unless you entered the options menu
[/list]

Quality of life changes
[list]
[*]Zoomed out the map for better visibility
[*]Added some floating particles in the background for visual interest
[/list]

Changed levels aesthetically to remove long water pools in front of gates (no changes to the solutions)
[list]
[*]Oblate
[*]Gyroelongation
[*]Nebula
[*]Pulsar

[/list]

notes.title: The Boomslang Update
notes.content:
Hello All,

I recently learned that the boomslang is a type of snake, and they look so cool that I had to name this update after them.

To make the flow of the levels more logical, I added five more introductory levels and rearranged the order of the levels to provide a smoother difficulty curve. Then because of the new level ordering, I updated the map to make the intended completion path more clear. 

I couldn’t resist throwing in some harder puzzles too. Try them if you dare! Note that if you did the thanks or secret levels, they will be removed from your snake and placed in their new map positions because I completely changed them.

Level changes
[list]
[*]Added new tutorial levels - The Test (level 4), Small Hallway (5), Slider (6), Chessboard (7), Antenna (8)
[*]Added new hard levels - Padlock (67), Do You Love Picross? (68), and ???. I replaced the old thanks level with "Do You Love Picross?" and the old secret level with "???"
[*]Sprawl (64) was slightly changed to make the level easier to see
[/list]

Other changes
[list]
[*]All the levels (especially the non-gate puzzles) were completely reordered, and the map was updated to fit this
[*]Moved the gray x that appears when a gate is unsatisfied behind the gate text so that the number on the gate is a little easier to read
[*]Fixed a game-crashing bug involving unsatisfied gates moving boxes when pushed
[*]Fixed a bug where the internal direction of the one-block-long snake did not match the displayed direction at the start of the map
[*]Added water around levels 2 and 3 so that they cannot be pushed into the snake’s reset position
[*]Added the feature that the snake is sorted by level number when reset
[*]Decreased the size of the level name text slightly so that it wouldn’t cover level tiles
[*]Made some changes to the storage format of the levels and the save file, there shouldn’t be any visible differences though
[/list]

Contact me if you find bugs or have suggestions!

notes.title: Level Selector Update
notes.content:
The player can now click on a level that they have already done to replay it.

Removed unnecessary complications (especially in the early-game):
Changed map to make the first level easier to start for the player
Added "You sunk (Press Z to undo or R to restart)" text to tell the player when they die
Stopped the snake head from going off the screen in the map

Bug fixes:
Fixed a bug where a gate locking a box directly in front of it could not be pushed in that direction (made level 53, Lode, impossible)
Prevented the player from exiting the map while sunk

I have tested this update, so hopefully there aren't any bugs. However, if you find any, please tell me about problems by commenting or emailing serpentfusiongame@gmail.com

notes.title: Improved Initial Levels and Fixed some Bugs!
notes.content:
I added some land to the top left corner of the map so you can experiment with the movement. The first three levels were also changed so that they teach you more and better allow you to experiment with the game mechanics.

Note: In the Mac version, the camera in the map sometimes jitters when you move. The game may also not start. To fix the camera, quit and restart the game. To fix the game not starting, uninstall and reinstall the game. I am not sure why this happens, as these bugs don't seem to occur on Windows.

Fixed these bugs:
When a gate was right next to a wall the gate line went through the wall
When one tile long, your sticky side was not visually consistent after undoing
Boxes phased into other boxes when pushed by gates
Crosses on gates disappeared after undoing
You could push boxes even if you did not move
You could phase into boxes if they were in gates
Some levels could go off the screen
Your head could go off the screen in the map
Boxes still had collision when sunk in water

Smaller level fixes:
Fixed levels 34 (Pulsar) and 35 (Quasar) to eliminate a shared solution
Eliminated a skip in level 48 (Decant)
Fixed level 56 (Circuit Breaker) to eliminate a skip and shortened the solution
Made a small aesthetic change to level 61 (Dread)

notes.title: Patch - September 29
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where restarting in the map while stuck to yourself prevented you from moving
Made camera in map move when you undo
Fixed a bug where level numbers in the map character were visible on the title screen
Fixed a scenario where you could get a box in the same tile as a character piece using gate mechanics
Fixed vsync issues
Fixed a bug where gate lines were drawn when the gate was not
